Repeating this gives everyone $10,000/month without depletion risk if all follow it. I intend to request 10 under this plan. Please state whether you support the same cap; higher requests threaten everyone's future income.

I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 leaves 250, so next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports $10,000 per person every month indefinitely. Larger requests risk losing this renewable income. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan; please state your intended limit. If stock is ever below 500, we should scale catches down together.
